notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register and firelookout.com agree on the 1932 platform and camp, the 1940 live-in tower and the gone-by-1950s date, but both appear to draw on the same survey, so this is not independent confirmation. Administering body is given as Clatsop FPA (register) and Oregon Department of Forestry - Clatsop FPA (Oregon Lookouts). No staffing, fires, access or current-condition source was found. The 2009 photo credited to Howard Verschoor on the register page was not added as a photo; no image URL was read. The register's gone-by-1950s date has no exact year, so no removal event is recorded.
